## Pinstant

Wake your device and go **straight to the passcode**: no Lock Screen, no swipe, no wait.

- Works when you wake with the **Home button**, the **side / lock button**, **Raise to Wake** or **Tap to Wake**.
- A screen lit by a notification, a call or an alarm is left alone, so you still see what woke it.
- Touch ID and Face ID keep working on the passcode screen.
- **No settings.** Install, respring, done. To turn it off, uninstall it.

- **arm64 and arm64e** (A12 and newer) builds, made with Xcode's toolchain and checked for the correct arm64e format.
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11)** with iOS 16.7 and Dopamine (Home button, side button and Raise to Wake). A12 and newer aren't confirmed yet: please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues). If it puts you into safe mode, open Sileo (safe mode still allows it) and uninstall it.

- Devices without a passcode aren't tested.
- Only for rootless jailbreaks with ElleKit (Dopamine).
Written from scratch by **John d_ie**. Concept from **UnlockOrElse** by **Ethan Whited (ETHN)**.
